### Our Glorious Inheritance in Christ
Author: Burk Parsons
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-glorious-inheritance-christ
Passage: Joshua 13:33
Points:
- Human consumerism creates an endless cycle of desiring just a little more.
- True contentment is found only by trusting God's sovereign provision and wisdom.
- Unlike the other tribes of Israel, the Levites received no physical land inheritance.
- God gave the Levites something far superior by giving them Himself as their portion.
- Believers are heirs to this same promise, finding their complete satisfaction in God alone.
